scope: Fixed frozen-model development diagnosis; no original Test evaluation or policy training

readouts.capacity: Four latent views padded to 62 columns, identical linear ridge recipe; raw graph reference separately disclosed larger width

adapter_intervention.probe: Identical observer in both arms; only model.enabled changes

statistics: Report per seed and paired tape differences, scenario macro with equal tape weights; no confirmatory significance or gain threshold
failure_policy: Stop on integrity/safety/weight mutation or time budget failure, preserve attempt without overwrite
interpretation: Disabling a co-trained adapter may shift its input distribution; this is not a GPPO-History control or independent GPPO comparison
